verdict.rationale: smolagents is a self-run library. The docs show you can access the agent's memory and use step callbacks to change it on the fly, which gives programmatic control over what the agent keeps. Support for local transformers/ollama models also lets data stay on the user's machine. None of this is framed as retention or deletion control, so the support is only indirect. Missing for 10: documented retention/deletion controls or policy, explicit memory-clearing or deletion API, guidance on data persistence for telemetry or Hub-shared agents, independent corroboration.
